item: The RSS and topic discovery routes in airplane mode ask nothing and say so
refs: PR #1570; R313 G2; found by PR #1558
summary: POST /api/sources/discover/rss answered 200 'Discovered RSS feeds for 0 sources' with total_checked counting sources it never asked about, and POST /api/sources/discover/topic (opt-in setting on) answered 200 'Discovered 0 sources for topic', because the DuckDuckGo wrapper swallows the kill switch's refusal into an empty list; and a third route of the same shape surfaced in the consent ratchet. Now a kill switch engaged before the call answers without calling the search: total_checked 0 or count 0, skipped_offline (the sources, or the one search, not asked; present only then) and a message naming the kill switch; one engaged DURING the run is flagged stopped_by_kill_switch on whatever it found. The opt-in 403 stays first; every other answer keeps its shape. SourceManager.rss_discovery_candidates was extracted so the count and the run ask the same question. The consent ratchet's two GAP rows became named rows proved by the real refusal; the table has no gap rows left.
